map_config.name: NumberGrid-48x48-v72-complete-unit-catalog
map_config.number_generation: Historical labels retained and copied with added squads. Numbers do not affect battles.
map_config.reconstruction_note: 48x48 map with 41 squads (27 × 1.5 rounded up). Starting capital and first nearby Squire retained; other original positions scaled by two. Fourteen additional human squads spread into the largest gaps, reusing existing compositions. The original three Orc/Goblin groups are unchanged. Titans occupy both slots of their formation line.
map_config.battle_recovery: Victory or retreat preserves all hero HP, including dead units at 0 HP. Full defeat ends the episode. Enemies reset after retreat. Rest heals living heroes by ceil(10% max HP). Paid healing and revival to 1 HP require the temple and exact starting cell (capital).
map_config.battle_engagement: A directional command targeting a living enemy stack starts combat from the current tile. Passing beside a stack is safe. Entry costs ceil(half the full movement allowance), capped at remaining points; zero points forbids attack. Victory and retreat keep the attacker on its original tile.
